::: {.qrtdown-source .dont-index}
Source: [`R/classes.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/classes.R)
:::

<p><code>value</code> records which column is being measured and what the resulting column
should be called. Assigning <code>new_column_name_vec</code> prefixes the supplied
string onto <code>value_vec</code>, so setting it to <code>"ytd"</code> for a value column of
<code>sales</code> gives <code>ytd_sales</code>.
</p>

## Usage

```r
value(value_vec = NA_character_, new_column_name_vec = character(0))
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-value-vec"><code>value_vec</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-value-vec"></a></dt>
<dd><p>The name of the value column, as a string.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-new-column-name-vec"><code>new_column_name_vec</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-new-column-name-vec"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A prefix for the output column; stored as
<code>paste0(prefix, "_", value_vec)</code>.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>value</code> S7 object.
</p>

## Additional properties

<dl>
<dt><code>@value_quo</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>value_vec</code> parsed to a symbol for tidy evaluation.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@new_column_name_quo</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>new_column_name_vec</code> parsed to a symbol.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
